task: Welcome to another fast paced game of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First, it would be fantastic if you could make an effort to take a trip west. With that accomplished, attempt to venture south. And then, make an attempt to head west. And then, make an effort to move north. Then, attempt to go north. With that over with, venture east. After that, venture east. And then, go to the east. After that, travel south. If you can finish that, attempt to move east. That done, retrieve the TextWorld limited edition passkey from the floor of the bedchamber. If you can get your hands on the TextWorld limited edition passkey, head north. That done, go west. After that, try to venture west. After that, move south. And then, look and see that the TextWorld limited edition hatch within the salon is unlocked. After that, doublecheck that the TextWorld limited edition hatch in the salon is wide open. Then, go to the south. Once you succeed at that, go to the east. And then, pick-up the key from the floor of the pantry. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
